title: Jesus' Baptism
description: Jesus comes from Galilee to the Jordan and is baptized by John. As he rises out of the water, the heavens open, the Spirit descends like a dove, and a voice from heaven says: "This is my Son, the beloved."

versions.title: Jesus' Baptism
versions.description: Jesus is baptized by John in the Jordan. The heavens open, the Spirit descends like a dove, and God speaks.
versions.reason: [minor] references: John 1:29-34 is John the Baptist's testimony about the baptism, not the baptism narrative itself. It can be included as supplementary testimony but is slightly off from the main story.
